text: I-VT operates on contiguous tracked segments. A sample is velocity-classified only when the left, middle, and right observations are all Tracked; Blink, Lost, and OffScreen close the current segment and are never event support. The first and final valid samples of a segment inherit their adjacent interior class, preserving endpoint support without estimating velocity across a boundary. Short class runs still emit no event, but DetectionResult retains their source samples as Unclassified. GapPolicy validation remains the artifact-level authority: repaired I-VT emits no native invalid support, bounded Bridge remains available to detectors that explicitly span gaps, and UseInterpolatedOnly is recorded for tracked samples whose origin is Interpolated.
